name: Götznerhof
beschreibung:
Set on the sunny plateau of Goetzens, Hotel Goetznerhof welcomes travellers with comfortable rooms, a relaxing spa area, and fine regional cuisine. It is a fantastic hub for city outings and mountain excursions.

The Nockspitzbahn cable car to Muttereralm, alpine trails, and the city of Innsbruck are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Goetznerhof in Goetzens features alpine comfort, spa wellness, and scenic views close to Innsbruck.
